mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( merchant_id, category_id, name, description, price, original_price, stock, sales, main_image, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{merchantId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{stock}, 0, #{mainImage}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, merchant_id, category_id, name, description, price, original_price, stock, sales, main_image, `status`, created_at, updated_at FROM products WHERE product_id = #{id}

SELECT product_id, merchant_id, category_id, name, description, price, original_price, stock, sales, main_image, `status`, created_at, updated_at FROM products WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND `status` = #{onSaleStatus} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT product_id, merchant_id, category_id, name, description, price, original_price, stock, sales, main_image, `status`, created_at, updated_at FROM products WHERE (name LIKE #{keyword} OR description LIKE #{keyword}) AND `status` = #{onSaleStatus} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM products WHERE (name LIKE #{keyword} OR description LIKE #{keyword}) AND `status` = #{onSaleStatus}
